description: This source file contains unit tests for the EmployeeReportingMethodService class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It tests methods related to retrieving subordinate and supervisor lists, counting subordinates, and managing supervisor IDs in the context of employee reporting relationships.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeReportingMethodService, testing its methods related to employee reporting relationships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService, and populates test data.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of subordinates for an employee via the service.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieving the count of immediate supervisors for an employee.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of subordinates for an employee, verifying subordinate data correctness.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of immediate supervisors for an employee, verifying supervisor data.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Verifies combination logic for accessible and available supervisor IDs, excluding already assigned IDs.

methods.name: testGetAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Checks combined list of supervisor IDs, subordinate IDs, and the employee's own ID.
